objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

objects.taxonomy_description: A suitcase is a rectangular, rigid or semi-rigid travel container with a handle, distinct from bags, boxes, or other luggage types.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a predominantly rectangular or box-like structure with defined edges and corners.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Handle_Presence: A distinct carrying handle is visible on the top or side, designed for hand-carrying.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Closure_Mechanism: The object features a visible zipper, latch, or clasp system running along the perimeter to secure two halves.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Rigidity: The surface appears structured and maintains its shape, distinguishing it from soft, unstructured fabric bags.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Contextual_Usage: The object is sized and shaped for holding personal items during travel, often seen alongside other luggage.
